messages.subject: Re: IRT parameters same for two scoring methods?

Hi Alicia,

The issue appears to be how the data were stored, as mirt's function anticipates that the category values are integer-based recordings (0,1,2,3) rather than decimals (0, .333, .666, etc). What's happening then is the input data is being coerced to integers via functions like as.integer(), which in your case rounds the .333 values down to 0 and .66 up to 1. If you want to keep these recording it's helpful to first wrap the values into factors and then unfactorize to obtain automated integer inputs, like this

partial[,1] <- factor(partial[,1]) |> as.integer()

HTH.

Phil


On Mon, Mar 11, 2024 at 6:40 PM Alicia <aliciast...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hello,

I have a data set that I have scored a few items from the set using a dichotomous method and also using a partial credit (polytomous) method. I want to compare how the IRT parameters change for the items based on the different scoring methods.

The items in particular that I am looking at are the first four columns. The rest of the item data stays the same for the items that are not my focus.

CTT shows there are differences in difficulty/discrimination for these four items when scored dichotomously vs. polytomously. But the IRT parameters keep coming out exactly the same. I'm stumped and appreciate any insight you may have.

Code follows, and example scored data attached.

Thanks,
Alicia

## Dichotomous

ncat.di <- apply(dichotomous, 2, function(x)length(unique(x[!is.na(x)])))

item.list.di <- unlist(lapply(ncat.di, function(x){if(x==2) item.list.di="2PL" else
item.list.di="graded"}))

mod.di <- mirt(dichotomous, itemtype = item.list.di)

DS_param_2PL <- coef(mod.di, IRTpars = TRUE, simplify = TRUE)

DS_param_2PL <- as.data.frame(DS_param_2PL$items)

View(DS_param_2PL)

itemanalysis_DS_ctt <- CTT::itemAnalysis(items = dichotomous)

View(itemanalysis_DS_ctt$itemReport)

## Partial (Polytomous)

ncat.part <- apply(partial, 2, function(x)length(unique(x[!is.na(x)])))

item.list.part <- unlist(lapply(ncat.part, function(x){if(x==2) item.list.part ="2PL" else
item.list.part ="graded"}))

mod.part <- mirt(partial, model=1, itemtype = item.list.part)

PC_param_2PL <- coef(mod.part, IRTpars = TRUE, simplify = TRUE)

PC_param_2PL <- as.data.frame(PC_param_2PL$items)

View(PC_param_2PL)

itemanalysis_PC_ctt <- CTT::itemAnalysis(items = partial)

View(itemanalysis_PC_ctt$itemReport)
